gasContract.terms: This contract is ongoing and may be terminated by you or us in accordance with the terms of our Market Agreement. The full terms and conditions applicable to this offer are available at https://tangoenergy.com/terms-and-conditions. For further information about this offer or our market terms, call Tango Energy on 1800 010 648.
gasContract.variation: Prices under this plan are variable and may be varied by notice to you. We will provide you with information about any variations in accordance with Energy Laws.

incentives.eligibility: Offer includes a one-off sign-up credit of $50 (incl. GST) provided you have not received a sign-up credit on your Tango Energy gas account (same property) in the past 12 months. Eligible customers will receive the credit on their first bill.

eligibility.information: Available to new residential gas customers of Tango Energy, or existing gas customers adding or moving to a new property. Requires monthly e-billing and direct debit. Applies to eligible residential gas meters in the specified distribution area.
